If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this + * file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/. */ + +import { html } from "lit"; +import "mail/themes/shared/mail/variables.css"; //eslint-disable-line import/no-unassigned-import +import "mail/themes/shared/mail/widgets.css"; //eslint-disable-line import/no-unassigned-import +import "mail/themes/shared/mail/icons.css"; //eslint-disable-line import/no-unassigned-import +import "mail/themes/shared/mail/containers.css"; //eslint-disable-line import/no-unassigned-import + +export default { + title: "Design System/Containers", + tags: ["autodocs"], +}; + +export const Containers = () => html` +

+ Each of these containers shown off are based on CSS classes provided by + chrome://messenger/skin/containers.css +

+`; + +export const SidebarPanelHeader = () => html` +
+
+
+ + + +
+
+
The header on the left side is created using the sidebar-panel-header class. It expects multiple buttons..
+
+`; + +export const SidebarPanelScroll = () => html` +
+
+ This scroll container has the sidebar-panel-scroll class, + adding a slight shadow effect when the container is scrolled. It relies on + the --sidebar-background variable to match the color of the + scrolling content. +
+
+`;
